systems.owner: Agence Togo Digital for the Ministry of Digital Economy and Digital Transformation

TGO.note: Platforms launched but no open data policy is named.

facts.fact: Togo's Ministry of Digital Economy, through Agence Togo Digital, announced on 19 December 2024 the Open Data platform (opendata.gouv.tg) with data on health, education and agriculture, and the Open Data Geoportal (geodata.gouv.tg), from which users can download datasets.
